name: Shirley Gordon
original_name: シャーリー・ゴードン
source:
Darius's daughter. Perhaps it is because of her age, but she strongly dislikes it when her father intervenes in her life. Born into a life of interacting with adults, she is very mature; far more knowledgeable than other children her age and capable of dealing with societal complications. Due to a certain event, she becomes friends with Cardia.

[From [url=http://aksysgames.com/crfb]the official website[/url]]
